title: Filtered admissible blowup system and completion-compatible closed fibres
statement: Let $(A,I)$ be a henselian pair with $I$ finitely generated [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology], let $A'=\widehat A$ be its $I$-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], and put $X=\operatorname{Spec}A$, $X'=\operatorname{Spec}A'$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], $U=X\setminus V(I)$, and $U'=X'\setminus V(IA')$. Let $\mathscr J(A,I)$ be the set of finitely generated ideals $J\subseteq A$ with $V(J)=V(I)$, and for $J\in\mathscr J(A,I)$ write $B_J=\operatorname{Bl}_J(X)$ [def-nagata-affine-blowup] and $Z_J=B_J\times_X\operatorname{Spec}(A/I)$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Order these blowups by domination: $J\preceq K$ when there is an $X$-morphism $B_K\to B_J$. Then this is a filtered preorder, and the restriction $j_J:U\hookrightarrow B_J$ is a schematically dense open immersion (the map $\mathcal O_{B_J}\to j_{J*}\mathcal O_U$ is injective) [lemma-nagata-admissible-blowup-over-open] for every $J$. Extension of ideals along $A\to A'$ induces an order-preserving cofinal identification of $\mathscr J(A,I)$ with the corresponding full-support admissible ideals for $(A',IA')$. For every $J$ and $m\geq1$, the canonical map on Rees powers induces compatible isomorphisms $(J^n/I^mJ^n)\xrightarrow{\sim}((JA')^n/I^m(JA')^n)$ for all $n\geq0$, and hence identifies the closed fibre $Z_J$ with the closed fibre of $\operatorname{Bl}_{JA'}(X')$ over $A'/IA'$.

source.place: Expose XX section 4.4, printed pp.373--374: definition of admissible J, filtered preorder, full-support uniqueness, and final Note on isomorphisms modulo powers of I.
